title: IEC 60335-2-23 Hair Care Appliance Testing India
description: IEC 60335-2-23 testing in India for hair dryers, straighteners and curling appliances. Test electrical and thermal safety with ITC India testing support.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Electrical hair-care appliances operate close to the user’s body and frequently contain heating elements, motors and high-temperature surfaces. Proper safety evaluation is therefore essential to reduce risks associated with electric shock, excessive temperature, fire, mechanical hazards and foreseeable abnormal use.

ITC India provides IEC 60335-2-23 testing in India for manufacturers, importers and product developers of hair-care and similar electrical appliances. IEC 60335-2-23 provides product-specific safety requirements and is applied together with the general requirements of IEC 60335-1. Manufacturers can also review ITC India’s IEC 60335-1 safety testing services when planning a complete appliance safety evaluation.

sections.heading: IEC 60335-2-23 and IEC 60335-1
paragraphs: IEC 60335-1 establishes the general safety requirements applicable to household and similar electrical appliances. IEC 60335-2-23 supplements and modifies those general requirements for hair-care and similar appliances.

A hair dryer, straightener or curling appliance should therefore not be evaluated only against Part 2-23. The applicable requirements of IEC 60335-1 and the particular product standard need to be considered together.
Manufacturers working with multiple appliance categories can also review ITC India’s wider IEC 60335 household appliance testing services.

sections.heading: IS 302-2-23 Testing for the Indian Market
paragraphs: Products intended for sale in India may also need evaluation against IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 23) and applicable BIS regulatory requirements.

The Indian Standard addresses electrical appliances for skin or hair care, while the latest international IEC 60335-2-23 scope has been revised to focus on hair-care and similar appliances. Because the applicable standard can depend on the destination market and regulatory route, manufacturers should confirm the required IEC or Indian Standard before starting formal compliance testing.
Early testing is valuable because failures involving insulation, temperature rise, supply cords, heating elements, protective components or abnormal operation may require product redesign.

sections.heading: Why Choose ITC India for IEC 60335-2-23 Testing?
paragraphs: ITC India supports manufacturers with product safety testing, interpretation of applicable requirements and identification of non-conformities during product development and compliance preparation.

For an accurate test plan, manufacturers should provide available product information such as rated voltage, power rating, model details, circuit diagrams, critical component lists, heating-element information, product labels, construction drawings and user instructions.
For IEC 60335-2-23 or IS 302-2-23 hair-care appliance testing in India, submit your product details through the ITC India testing inquiry form.

sections.heading: What is IEC 60335-2-23?
paragraphs: IEC 60335-2-23 specifies particular safety requirements for electrical hair-care and similar appliances. It is used together with the general household appliance safety requirements of IEC 60335-1.

sections.heading: Which appliances are covered by IEC 60335-2-23?
paragraphs: Typical products include hair dryers, hair straighteners, curling irons, curling combs, hand dryers and other hair-care appliances falling within the standard’s defined scope.

sections.heading: Does IEC 60335-2-23 cover electric shavers?
paragraphs: No. Electric shavers, hair clippers and similar appliances are addressed under IEC 60335-2-8 rather than IEC 60335-2-23.

sections.heading: Is IS 302-2-23 relevant in India?
paragraphs: Yes. IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 23) applies to relevant skin- and hair-care electrical appliances in India. Manufacturers should verify current BIS and Quality Control Order requirements for their specific product.

sections.heading: What documents are required for hair dryer safety testing?
paragraphs: Useful documents include product specifications, rated electrical values, circuit diagrams, component lists, heating-element details, construction drawings, labels and user manuals.

sections.heading: Can ITC India test hair dryers and hair straighteners?
paragraphs: ITC India can evaluate applicable electrical and product-safety requirements for hair-care appliances based on the relevant IEC or Indian Standard and the intended destination market.
